title: Popup
hint: Click Add line: the popup opens above and to the right of the button. Add more lines: when the popup no longer fits above the button it opens below, and when it fits nowhere it is pushed back into the box. Click Remove line: the popup shrinks and goes back above the button. Click the popup or press Escape to close it.
tweak: In the JavaScript tab, set stick to "none" and add eight lines: the popup leaves the box at the bottom.

scenarios.name: above and to the right of the button when there is room
below the button once the popup has grown too tall for the room above
above the button again after a line is removed
pushed back into the box when it fits neither above nor below
